disposition_mapping.rationale: The employee-initiated submission with receipt attachment for lines above threshold is preserved as the entry point of the redesigned flow, now via a self-service digital portal; EXR-R-01 and EXR-R-10 remain satisfied.

Manual receipt capture and data extraction by an AP analyst is subsumed into automated OCR/extraction performed at the point of submission; this step is unconstrained by design, so its function moves inside the submission step rather than persisting separately.

The policy compliance check is reorganised as an automated rules-engine check with human exception handling, satisfying EXR-R-07 (step survives) and continuing to precede manager approval per EXR-R-02.
Line manager approval is unchanged in substance, satisfying EXR-R-08; it remains distinct from the employee-actor submission step, preserving EXR-R-03, and precedes reimbursement per EXR-R-06.

Finance review of coding, exceptions and evidence is unconstrained by design and is folded into the automated posting step as an exception-triggered review, preserving the evidential control from KB-02 without requiring full manual review of every claim.

Posting is reorganised into an automated process that still consumes the expense transaction date (EXR-R-04) and transaction-date exchange rate (EXR-R-05), per KB-01 accrual basis and KB-07 FX translation, with exception routing preserving the error-correction and evidence principles of KB-02 and KB-05.

Reimbursement via the AP payment run survives unchanged in substance, satisfying EXR-R-09, and continues to occur only after manager approval per EXR-R-06, preserving determinable payables derecognition per KB-11.

Employee notification is unconstrained by design and is merged into the reimbursement step as an automated confirmation triggered by payment completion, rather than persisting as a separate manual step.

steps.description: The employee submits an out-of-pocket expense claim via self-service portal; receipt images for claim lines above the receipt threshold are automatically captured and their data extracted into a structured claim record at the point of submission, eliminating the separate manual capture step.
inputs: Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold
steps.name: Digital claim submission with automated receipt capture

steps.description: A rules engine automatically checks claim lines against expense policy limits, categories and per diem rates. Non-compliant lines are flagged and routed to an AP analyst for exception review before the claim proceeds to manager approval.
steps.name: Automated policy compliance check

steps.description: The claimant's line manager reviews and approves or rejects the policy-checked claim.
steps.name: Line manager approval

steps.description: Approved claims are automatically posted to expense accounts and cost centres in the period the expense was incurred, translating foreign-currency lines at the transaction-date exchange rate. Claims with coding anomalies, residual policy exceptions or insufficient supporting evidence are routed to a finance reviewer before posting is finalised, preserving the evidential review function without requiring full manual review of every claim.
steps.name: Automated posting with finance exception review

steps.description: The approved claim is paid to the employee through the AP payment run, and the employee is automatically notified upon confirmation of payment.
steps.name: Reimbursement via AP payment run with automated notification
